title: Cochain transport of tensor and counit squares
statement: For a scheme X, take an additive strong monoidal left adjoint P⊣S=Γ(X,-), a derived functor D⊣R, a natural homotopy comparison α:Qh⋙D→P_h⋙Qh, and derived tensor isomorphisms δ. Assume the full homotopy tensor diagram and the homotopy counit/unit square. Let β be exactly the canonical right-derived unit transported to cochains, and a the explicitly constructed [def-sc-module-cup-cochain-pullback-comparison]. Then for all section complexes A,B, D(μQ(A,B));a(A⊗B);Q(δP_c(A,B))=δ(QA,QB);(aA⊗aB);μQ(P_cA,P_cB). For every sheaf complex K, D(βK);ε(QK)=a(S_cK);Q(e.εK). This only transports the assumed squares; it has no naive cup, pairing φ or cup transpose μ. The supplied cochain lax structure is explicitly assumed equal to DerivedCategory.laxMonoidalQ; its source tensor constraint is computed with that supplied structure.

proof.text: Apply the assumed homotopy tensor and counit equations to quotient images. The quotient tensor constraints are identities, the induced oplax comparison and induced counit are the quotient of the cochain maps, and quotientCompQhIso identifies Qh of quotient maps with Q. Conjugate the equations by this natural isomorphism, substitute the concrete definitions of a and β, and cancel its inverse pairs.
